يمتطون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَطُونَ (yamtaṭūna) /jam.ta.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# يُمْتَطَوْنَ (yumtaṭawna) /jum.ta.tˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
